_description: config.local.json is shallow-merged on top of config.json (local wins) and is automatically gitignored by .gw/.gitignore. Put OTLP auth headers (secrets) HERE, never in the committed config.json.
_usage: Save as .gw/config.local.json. NOTE: the merge is shallow, so this 'telemetry' block REPLACES the one in config.json entirely — repeat every field you still need (enabled/endpoint/environment), not just the secret.
